note: Same signature, Profile m and world w; NecessaryAt m.ontic w n is box-existence over m.ontic.frame by Iff.rfl. Same witness n: keep that n is an actual root, box-exists, is GOD_4, the one GOD_4 and has the classical attributes field. Strictness (non-degenerate in this sense: no supplied predicate is emptied so that an attribute fails): the two-point separator has two actual roots of which only one is GOD_4; in its main model six relations are empty, so several attributes hold vacuously, and a restored-relation control with non-empty orders, causation, potency, composition and matter/form (component-of still empty) gives the same result; in both the strong version fails only through its selected-root uniqueness conjunct, which the weak version lacks (its IsTheOneGod is uniqueness among GOD_4 bearers only). Syntactically the strong version also adds maximum, perfection, esse/essence identity, firstness, matter/form exclusion, remoteness and eight further case predicates; the separator does not model-separate those. No certified difference (strength_comparison, #1598) is registered: the sense-fork precedents factor through a witness-independent frame condition, while here the added content constrains the witness of an existential, so a delta would need a new same-witness delta statement and its equivalence proof (not attempted).
